So I mentioned before I work in disability services, but I’m starting my master’s in social work and the focus of my work is in the way various disorders work and manifest through the body. Think eating disorders, self-injury, trichotillomania, obsessive body modification, and the favorite of all self diagnosers, body dysmorphic disorder (BDD). BDD is basically an obsession over flaws in appearance.

Some of the clients I have seen include:

  • a 17 year old girl who was always very put together and conventionally attractive. She had been waking up nearly 4 hours before school started to prepare her appearance.
  • a woman in her early twenties with a severe self-injury problem who had tried to skin herself, succeeding in cutting off multiple 4x2 inch pieces of skin. The wounds were then infected because she kept re-opening them.
  • a teenager who, using tweezers, had individuals plucked out their eyebrows, eyelashes, and almost all of their pubic hair
  • many, many, many eating disorder clients who broke down crying over being asked to eat at least 2 meals a day
  • 2 male-to-female transgender clients who attempted to self-castrate. Cutting on the genitals because of other reasons was also pretty common.
